name: Composer: microphone off
what: With the microphone refused, the composer says "Microphone access is off." with Open Settings beside the crossed-out mic (was a crossed-out mic with no word).
steps: Android Settings > Apps > Off Grid AI > Permissions > Microphone > Don't allow.
Open any chat and look above the composer.

name: Composer: camera off
what: Take photo with the camera refused says "Camera access is off." with Open Settings above the composer (was nothing).
steps: Refuse Camera for Off Grid AI in Android Settings.
In a chat with a vision model: Attach > Take photo.

name: Sync: not on Wi-Fi
what: Off Wi-Fi, the Sync devices card says "This phone is not on Wi-Fi." with Try again (was a bare Offline).
steps: Turn Wi-Fi off (mobile data on); Pro on.

name: Screenshot sharing: photo access off
what: Screenshot sharing turned on with photo access refused shows "Photo access is off." with Open Settings on its row.
steps: Refuse Photos and videos for Off Grid AI in Android Settings.
Settings > Sync > Automatic sharing > Screenshots: choose Ask or Auto.

name: Day, Reflect, Entities, Search: capture state
what: Each header shows capture state with its control (Paused / Permission required / Stopped with Resume / Review permissions / Restart), so capture off never reads as a quiet day.
steps: Open Day, Reflect, Entities and Search.

name: Replay, Reflect, Day, Meetings calendar: failed load
what: A failed read says why with Try again instead of No frames / No activity / No meetings.
steps: Make the database busy or unreadable, then open each screen.

name: Clipboard: capture off
what: With capture off the empty state says Clipboard capture is off. with Turn on (was Nothing copied yet).
steps: Clipboard > Settings > turn capture off, go back.

name: Clipboard: quick paste cannot work
what: Under the search: The quick paste shortcut is in use by another app, or Accessibility access is off. Open Settings after a paste that could not type.
steps: Hold Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+C in another app, then open Off Grid AI; or paste from the popup without Accessibility.

name: Dictation: shortcut and hold
what: Shortcut in use by another app: Change shortcut. Hold without Accessibility: Accessibility access is off. Open Settings, and the header says Tap.
steps: Revoke Accessibility, set mode to Hold, open Dictation.
